\section{Test against ref, per benchmark}

Each value pools all runs of a benchmark in that input ($\sum$ numerators
$/ \sum$ denominators): the inputs have different runs (\ct{xz}: 12 test
runs, 3 ref runs). Test values come from full simulations, ref values are
SimPoint estimates. Ref values are SimPoint estimates: per run up to 30 simulation points of 100M instructions, each after a 500M-instruction warmup, weighted by SimPoint; a counter of the whole ROI is $N \cdot \sum_i w_i c_i / n_i \,/\, \sum_i w_i$ ($N$ the ROI length from the qemu profile, $n_i$ and $c_i$ the instructions and the counter of point $i$, $w_i$ its weight). Only benchmarks that finished in both
inputs and all five configurations are shown (23). Data as of 2026-11-19 10:30.
The program ratios do not depend on the cache; the miss rates are given per
configuration \trgloss{test ve ref girdilerinin benchmark baz{\i}nda kar\c{s}{\i}la\c{s}t{\i}rmas{\i}}.

spill/roi & (\ct{roi\_spill\_load} $+$ \ct{roi\_spill\_store}) / \ct{roi\_total\_insts}: \textbf{the main metric}, spill-like instructions (\textit{ana metrik: stack'e yazma veya stack'ten geri okuma pay{\i}}). \\
spill ld/load & \ct{roi\_spill\_load} / \ct{roi\_load}: loads that read a stack-written value back (\textit{load'lar{\i}n y\"uzde ka\c{c}{\i} stack'ten geri okuma}). \\
spill st/store & \ct{roi\_spill\_store} / \ct{roi\_store}: stores to the stack, read back or not (\textit{store'lar{\i}n y\"uzde ka\c{c}{\i} stack'e}). \\
spill ev/spill st & \ct{roi\_spill\_event} / \ct{roi\_spill\_store}: reuse rate of the stack writes (\textit{stack'e yaz{\i}lanlar{\i}n y\"uzde ka\c{c}{\i} geri kullan{\i}ld{\i}}). \\
spill/mem & (\ct{roi\_spill\_load} $+$ \ct{roi\_spill\_store}) / (\ct{roi\_load} $+$ \ct{roi\_store}): spill-like share of the memory instructions (\textit{bellek trafi\u{g}inin y\"uzde ka\c{c}{\i} spill-like}). \\
pooled & $\sum$ numerators $/ \sum$ denominators over the completed runs: large runs dominate (\textit{b\"ut\"un ko\c{s}ular birlikte; b\"uy\"uk ko\c{s}ular bask{\i}n}). \\
mean & Average of the benchmark values: every benchmark weighs the same (\textit{benchmark de\u{g}erlerinin ortalamas{\i}}). \\
\end{tabularx}\par}
